text: Free demo: the stairs are closed, and you're too claustrophobic for the elevator.
So you climb the building from the outside.
Your only tool is a plank gun. Shoot a plank into the wall, jump on it, shoot the next.
Planks are limited, and not every wall takes one. Miss a shot and you're stuck.
The camera loves pointing straight down. It's properly dizzying.
The catch? The buildings and props look pretty basic.
Both demo reviews are positive, and the full game is due in December.
Think Only Up, with a nail gun.
Worth a dip. Get home before your coffee gets cold.
